subject: Exception on runApp with R version 3.0.2

messages.author: f7825395596c3639
messages.subject: Exception on runApp with R version 3.0.2
parts:
Hi,  I am running a shiny app using R version 3.0.2.   when I do a runApp('......') I get this exception,  has anyone encountered this before.   It was running fine with v 3.0 and the only thing I did was upgrade to 3.0.2 and installed devtools and shinyIncubator packages.

terminate called after throwing an instance of '__gnu_cxx::recursive_init_error'
  what():  std::exception
Abort trap

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Exception on runApp with R version 3.0.2
parts:
There has been some churn around Rcpp. I'd start with this:

install.packages(c("Rcpp", "httpuv", "shiny"))

Please let us know if that fixes it or not. Thanks.
